name: ClearWorthPlanner
summary: A local-first Windows finance workspace with dashboards, budgets, Planning Studio, guided Secure Sync and editable bank import review. Version 1.3.1 is available as an unsigned installer; bank linking has limited trial availability.

name: Pairvoy
summary: Pairvoy helps couples plan personal and shared goals, track goal and weekly action progress independently, and celebrate milestone rewards. Version 0.5.20 is live in the browser; Windows and Android 0.5.19 downloads remain available until the new installers are published.

name: Pairvoy for Family
summary: Plan personal and shared family goals, give everyone a next step, and celebrate progress together. The 0.1.4 preview stores family profiles and progress on one device.

name: ClaimField
summary: ClaimField Beta: a browser workspace for prospect land review, claim planning, terrain-aware crew tracks, scheduling, filing preparation and encrypted sharing.

name: Study Companions
summary: Four self-contained, offline HTML study workspaces for Esri professional certification preparation, with flashcards, practice exams, and documentation links.
